data.title: History & Batch Tracking
data.goalStatement: The History tab plus the local persistence layer behind it: every batch ever sent is recorded with its frozen frame, per-annotation records, generated prompt and hierarchy dump, and listed grouped by time period with a thumbnail crop, title/summary, timestamp and status chip (Fixed, In progress, etc.). All records survive app restarts and never leave the machine. Why: PER-2 needs to see what has already been reported and its state without re-testing everything, and the Verify loop needs a durable original-frame record to diff against.
data.rawDescription: The History tab plus the local persistence layer behind it: every batch ever sent is recorded with its frozen frame, per-annotation records, generated prompt and hierarchy dump, and listed grouped by time period with a thumbnail crop, title/summary, timestamp and status chip (Fixed, In progress, etc.). All records survive app restarts and never leave the machine. Why: PER-2 needs to see what has already been reported and its state without re-testing everything, and the Verify loop needs a durable original-frame record to diff against.

functionalRequirements.text: Provide a History tab listing every batch ever sent, grouped by time period, each row showing a thumbnail crop, title/summary, timestamp, and a status chip (e.g. Fixed, In progress).

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: All mirror stream data, screenshots, hierarchy dumps, and payloads stay local to the machine; no network egress beyond localhost MCP communication.
History and batch metadata persist locally and survive app restarts.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given batches have been sent previously, when the History tab is opened, then batches are grouped by time period, each showing thumbnail, summary, timestamp, and status chip.
Given History contains at least one batch, when the app is quit and relaunched, then all batches, their status chips, stored frozen frames, and per-annotation records are still present and openable.

scenarios.title: Review and verify a batch in History
steps: Diff runs per annotation against the frozen frame

scenarios.title: History survives an app restart
steps: Both batches, statuses and stored frames are intact

userStories.iWant: a History tab listing every batch I've sent grouped by time with status chips
userStories.soThat: I can see what's fixed or in progress without re-testing everything
